title: Praxis ground-truth labels for one recorded clip (praxis.labels/1)
description: One file per clip, next to it: raw/<participant>/<exercise>/<timestamp>.labels.json. Written by services/session/tools/label_clip.py; validated by tools/dataset_v1.py:validate_labels. Times are seconds from the first frame of the clip (frame_index / fps). Indices are 0-based and match the pipeline's events: NHPT `hole` 0..8, cup `to_dot` 0..4 (printed dot number minus 1).

labeller.description: Initials of the person who labelled (not the participant).

complete.description: true once every rep in the clip is labelled; eval.py scores complete files only.

nhpt.description: NHPT only. t_start = first peg lifted, t_end = ninth peg seated (the product's timer definition). Derived from the reps when the labeller saves.

drops.description: NHPT only: times a peg was dropped.

t_start.description: Arm: arm starts to move. Cup: cup lifted off its dot. NHPT: peg lifted from the dish.

t_end.description: Arm: arm back at the start position (pendulum: one full to-and-fro swing done). Cup: cup set down on the next dot. NHPT: peg seated in the hole.

expected.description: What the product SHOULD say: verified = a correct rep, fully visible; unverified = the camera could not or should not verify it (occluded, marker lost, swing too small, hold too short, target missed).

reason.description: Why the rep should be unverified (occluded, marker_lost, swing_too_small, hold_too_short, target_missed, other).

deliberate_error.description: Set when the participant performed a scripted error rep (PROTOCOL.md).

peak_deg_goniometer.description: Arm lifts: shoulder angle read from the goniometer app at the top of the rep (PROTOCOL.md). null when not measured.

lean.description: Trunk visibly leaned during the rep.

hike.description: Shoulder visibly shrugged/hiked during the rep.
